newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch find human skulls, baby corpse at airport.
newsitem.headline: Dutch find human skulls, baby corpse at airport.

text.p: Seven human skulls and the mummified corpse of a baby have been found in a container at Amsterdam's Schiphol airport, Dutch customs said on Friday.
"There were seven skulls, some still with some hair and skin attached, and the dried-out body of a baby probably somewhere around birth age," customs spokesman Peter Mulder said.
The human remains were found last Sunday during a routine drugs check, concealed amongst handicrafts in a cargo container in transit from Peru to an address in Belgium, he said.
The find was not immediately announced in order to give police in the Netherlands and Belgium time to begin an investigation, he added.
In September last year, Dutch police discovered mummified babies' body parts, some stuffed inside ritual dolls, at the Amsterdam home of a man claiming to be a voodoo witchdoctor.
